title: Tiny, cute jack-o'-lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- stem -->
    <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#4f8a2b'/>
    <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6db33f'/>
    <!-- pumpkin body: two lobes forming round shape -->
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='58' rx='26' ry='28' fill='#f0862c'/>
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='58' rx='26' ry='28' fill='#f0862c'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='29' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
    <!-- vertical ridges, lighter shade -->
    <path d='M36 32 Q34 58 36 86' stroke='#ffb46b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M64 32 Q66 58 64 86' stroke='#ffb46b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M50 30 Q50 58 50 87' stroke='#ffb46b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- face carved: eyes as glowing triangles -->
    <path d='M34 50 L44 50 L39 62 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <path d='M56 50 L66 50 L61 62 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <path d='M50 62 L46 70 L54 70 Z' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <!-- smiling jagged mouth -->
    <path d='M32 72 L38 78 L42 72 L46 78 L50 72 L54 78 L58 72 L62 78 L68 72 L64 82 L36 82 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  </g>
</svg>
